description: Every lot publicly on offer in the catalogues the lot index reads each day (companies' records, codebases, footage, speech, environments), in one vocabulary: kind, industry, years of history, systems, size, what its catalogue says about the rights and whether it is ready, each linked to its catalogue's own page. We have not checked any catalogue's claims. No holder is named. Longest history first.

industry.description: The holder's industry, as this site names industries.

kind.description: The kind of data: company-records (Company records), source-code (Source code), video (Video and footage), audio-speech (Audio and speech), images (Images), text-archives (Text and archives), datasets-environments (Datasets, tasks and environments), physical-world (Physical-world data), expert-work (Expert and human work).

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 10, at most 50).

query.description: Words that must all appear in the lot's title, line of business or systems.

rights.description: "settled": the lot's own catalogue says its holder has the rights with nothing left to confirm; "open": the catalogue names conditions or consent still to confirm. We have not checked either.

name: find_lots
title: Find data on offer across brokers' catalogues
